desc: Derive per-composition edge-count polynomial: within-layer factors (1+x)^{C(s,2)} and between-layer "every vertex has ≥1 neighbor below" factors f_{a,b}(x) via inclusion–exclusion.
Replace composition enumeration with DP over (even_sum, odd_sum, last_layer_size, parity) states holding edge-count polynomials (avoids 2^28 blowup).
Handle labeling via inv_fact[s] per layer multiplied into transitions, times fact[N−1] at the end (P > 30 guarantees invertibility).
Design overflow-safe modular convolution (15-bit split + np.convolve, int64-safe) and degree truncation to C(N,2).
Implement the full Python solution (precomputations, g-table, layer DP, final aggregation and output).
Verify against samples N=4, N=6, N=10; sanity-check N=2 (expect 1) and timing for N=30; fix any bugs found.
